name: Sequence CFA Cosmetic Correction (seqcosme_cfa)
description:
Same command as COSME_CFA but for the the sequence sequencename . Only selected images in the sequence are processed.

The output sequence name starts with the prefix "cosme_" unless otherwise specified with option -prefix=

Links: cosme_cfa

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.
